Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Travis Head and Josh Inglis to open for Australia. Matthew Forde to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

Australia will back themselves to chase this down. The wicket is really good and they have quality in their line-up. Windies on the other hand, need wickets and at regular intervals if they are to stay in the game or the hosts can just cruise to this target? Join us back for the reply in a bit.

An excellent bowling performance comes to an end by the Aussies. It was Xavier Bartlett who began things brilliantly by taking three in no time. Courtesy him, the Windies were in big trouble at around 60 for 4. The visitors though then fought back as Chase and Keacy Carty put up a really good partnership. Both scored half tons and then, Windies looked all set to reach the 250-run mark at least. However, once Chase fell, Keacy Carty also departed quickly and the lower order struggled to score runs. The Aussie bowlers came back strongly towards the end. Sean Abbott and Cameron Green gave really good support to Xavier Bartlett as they picked up two each. Steven Smith will be very satisfied as of now.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a really good catch by Marnus Labuschagne! He redeems himself for a missing a run out on the last delivery. This is short and on middle, Hayden Walsh steps out and pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket. Marnus Labuschagne runs to his right and takes it with a slide. West Indies HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 231!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! That has flown off the middle. That is a seriously good hit. Short and on the body. Carty stands tall and pulls it over the fine leg fence. First biggie of the game. Top shot. Just used the pace and it flew over the fine leg fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Lance Morris to Keacy Carty, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, good length, defended.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Lance Morris to Keacy Carty, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and around off. This is slapped last cover, not right off the middle but two taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Lance Morris to Keacy Carty, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Probably doing a little too much. This is full and it starts around middle. Shapes back in late. AA looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. He just needed to begin from around off. End of a brilliant first over by the debutant though. Well, well, well, Hawk Eye shows three reds. Missed opportunity.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Xavier Bartlett to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Just wide. Fuller again and shaping away. Carty looks to drive, this goes off the outside edge and past gully. Towards third man for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Xavier Bartlett to Keacy Carty, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off, blocked.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Xavier Bartlett to Keacy Carty, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TIMBER! That is a beauty! That is an absolute beaut to get your first ODI wicket for the Aussies. What a feeling for Xavier Bartlett and he is ecstatic. Brilliant in the recently concluded Big Bash and now makes an impact at the biggest stage straightaway. This starts around middle, it shapes away late. Slightly fuller. Greaves looks to drive but is done in by the Kate away movement. It goes past the outside edge and hits the stumps. A beauty.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Xavier Bartlett to Justin Greaves, OUT! b Xavier Bartlett.

Commentary.Commentary: This is angled into the pads, the one that goes on with the angle. Greaves looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Xavier Bartlett to Justin Greaves, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A beauty to begin with! This lands around off and shapes away. Greaves looks to defend but is beaten.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Xavier Bartlett to Justin Greaves, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Xavier Bartlett to bowl from the other end. Here we go...
Back of a length and around off, Alick stands tall and defends. A good first over then for the Windies.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Lance Morris to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, shortish, this is guided towards backward point and he too is off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Lance Morris to Justin Greaves, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Into the pads, Greaves looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Lance Morris to Justin Greaves, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, Alick waits and guides it down to third man for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Lance Morris to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Clipped away. Just uses the pace. Good way to get things underway for the Windies. On the pads, this is clipped past square leg and the ball races away.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Lance Morris to Alick Athanaze, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: That is a really good but to begin. In the 140s, on a length and around off. Alick Athanaze looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin. Out walk the Windies openers, Justin Greaves and Alick Athanaze. Lance Morris to steam in. Here we go...
West Indies (Playing XI) - Justin Greaves, Alick Athanaze, Keacy Carty, Shai Hope (C/WK), Kavem Hodge, Roston Chase, Romario Shepherd, Matthew Forde, Hayden Walsh, Gudakesh Motie, Oshane Thomas.
Australia (Playing XI) - Travis Head, Josh Inglis (WK), Cameron Green, Steven Smith (C), Marnus Labuschagne, Matthew Short, Aaron Hardie, Sean Abbott, Xavier Bartlett, Lance Morris, Adam Zampa.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

It's time for the first ODI after an action packed Test series. Windies will head into the contest with a lot of confidence after creating history in the second Test. Also, they have been in decent form in this format as they just beat England back in their den. They though are up against the mighty Aussies and need to be at their very best if they are to have a chance. Can they upset the odds?
...Match Day...
